title: kate-core: replace the selections of a view
summary: Command::MoveTo(Selections) stores the given selections on the view after clamping every offset to the buffer length. The window uses it for mouse clicks, alt-click carets, find hits, and visual-row moves. The buffer does not change.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

definitions.definition:
/// Clamp every anchor and head to the buffer length and store the selections.
fn move_to_cmd(ws: &mut Workspace, view: ViewId, target: &Selections) -> Result<(), CommandError>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add MoveTo(Selections) after Move in command.rs and import Selections there. Add the arm to run_motion. move_to_cmd maps each selection so anchor and head are at most buffer.len(), keeps goal_col None, builds Selections::new with the same primary index, and stores it. The test move_to_clamps_and_stores_the_selections types abc, executes MoveTo with one selection anchor 1 head 9, and asserts the view selection is anchor 1 head 3. It then executes MoveTo with two carets at 0 and 2 with primary 1 and asserts two selections and primary head 2. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::move_to_clamps_and_stores_the_selections
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because Command::MoveTo does not exist. After the change a head past the end is clamped and two carets are stored with the given primary.
